newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LIGHTNING GOAL PUTS BAYERN TOP OF BUNDESLIGA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIGHTNING GOAL PUTS BAYERN TOP OF BUNDESLIGA.

text.p: A lightning strike from Alexander Zickler after just 15 seconds gave Bayern Munich a 1-0 win over Werder Bremen on Saturday and catapulted them back to the top of the Bundesliga.
Ruggiero Rizzitelli provided the perfect cross for Zickler, who headed past Bremen goalkeeper Oliver Reck to notch his third goal in a week.
The win moved Bayern above Borussia Dortmund, who had gone top on Thursday after beating St Pauli 1-0.
Bayer Leverkusen also moved above Dortmund and into second place thanks to a 2-0 win over UEFA Cup semifinalists Schalke. Leverkusen are two points behind Bayern and a point ahead of Dortmund.
